# CopperJoint

> CopperJoint® manufactures copper-infused compression wear designed for pain relief, joint support, and athletic recovery across the body.

CopperJoint offers a comprehensive range of compression products including socks, sleeves, and braces infused with copper technology. The product line targets diverse customer segments including athletes, healthcare workers, pregnant individuals, and those seeking everyday comfort and circulation support.

## Key Topics

- Copper-infused compression
- Compression socks
- Joint support
- Pain relief
- Athletic recovery
- Circulation support
- Compression sleeves
- Knee braces
- Ankle support
- Shoulder braces
- Wrist support
- Injury recovery
- Mobility support
- Healthcare workers
- Maternity support
